investigations.name: Stadtwerke Aschersleben GmbH
investigations.decision: remain partial; bounded six-site LichtBlick estate identified but anonymous semantics/fees not closed

evidence.currentEstate: Six Stadtwerke Aschersleben sites / 18 charge points observed in current LichtBlick-derived inventory
evidence.energyEvidence: Current LichtBlick-derived records show 0.36 EUR/kWh incl VAT on multiple exact DE*BDO AC EVSEs, including Kopernikusstrasse, Klopstockstrasse and eight Magdeburger-Strasse connectors.
evidence.paymentEvidence: The same structured records expose RFID as payment method, while a current E-Center public surface confirms ad-hoc direct charging exists but leaves its direct price unknown.

investigations.exactGap: Energy coverage strongly suggests a homogeneous 0.36 EUR/kWh LichtBlick/RFID layer across the six-site estate, but anonymous_ad_hoc direct price equivalence and complete fee stack are not authoritative for every EVSE. Do not substitute RFID/registered pricing.
investigations.resumeCondition: Public LichtBlick direct-payment/QR checkout or authoritative per-EVSE anonymous fields proving 0.36 EUR/kWh plus all start/time/blocking fees across all 18 points.

consistencyCheck.channelSeparation: PASS; RFID evidence not substituted for anonymous_ad_hoc

nextSafeAction: Use the LichtBlick family only if a public direct-payment payload can expose anonymous fields for DE*BDO EVSEs; otherwise move to another AFIR/Mobilithek candidate with explicit anonymous fee fields.
